question: What effect does worship of this Ketu mantra produce for its practitioners?
premises: There are worshippers of this mantra.
Ketus are associated with this mantra.
The Ketus move in front of these worshippers.
inference: Worship of this Ketu mantra causes the Ketus to move ahead of its practitioners.
plain_english: Indeed, the Ketus move in front of the worshippers of this mantra.
